readonlyPreflight.scope: four protected service baselines and three protected configuration baselines; not universal integrity

maintenanceRequirements: Separate explicit maintenance approval before any production switch
Freeze a complete deployable candidate and verify exact hashes
Recheck compatibility proof freshness; expired evidence cannot authorize publication
Size and verify an application-consistent maintenance backup; per-database rehearsal copies are not equivalent
Preserve 55-second forward and 120-second total recovery limits, one-shot gate and rollback restrictions
Do not overwrite new writes or remove pre-existing locks
No changes to credentials, grants, DNS, ports, legacy LACK or Relay
